Tool versions MUST use SemVer, and schema versions MUST

Alfred MUST provide tooling output as JSON or NDJSON,

As an agent user, I need background operations with streaming
output, cancellation, timeouts, and introspection so that
expensive work does not block interactive steps or run away.
When claiming atomic mutations, Alfred MUST implement an
atomic write/replace strategy that is correct on
Linux/macOS/Windows; if atomic replacement cannot be
guaranteed (e.g., locked destination on Windows), Alfred MUST
fail explicitly rather than partially applying changes.

No Shell by Default for Task Execution
Task execution MUST default to argv-based process spawning
(no shell) to avoid cross-platform quoting differences and
injection risks; shell execution MUST be explicitly requested
